title: Water Wonder
physical_identity: Infinite indoor waterpark of decaying slides over dry pools, plastic blue-grass landscaping, dark metal-floor corridors, dim cafes and concrete storerooms.
scale_topology: Infinite indoor; four room types joined by Corridors; storerooms about 3x as common as waterparks.
anomalies: unlimited free vending machines (never restock once opened)
lighting_sound: Corridors dark with scarce lights; storeroom fluorescents black out for 4 s to ~5 h 20 min; noisy metal floors; cafes dim.

entities.name: Windows
entities.behavior: rare, appear in windows; keep distance

entities.name: Wretch
entities.behavior: single case in a waterpark, killed by the tribe

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Smilers, Dullers, Windows (rare), one Wretch instance
hazards: rusted slides and beams may collapse
items_communities: Almond Water, crisps, Greasy Marshmallows, Warpberries from vending machines
Cafe Tegan, Storage Facility 058-1, Fruit Farm, Bunk Room

entrances.quote: only present itself to groups of at least 3 wanderers

entrances.method: unlock any door with the Level Key
entrances.quote: Unlocking any door using Level 58's Level Key will lead here.

entrances.method: find and tear an old Water Wonder flyer
entrances.quote: Finding an old flyer advertising 'Water Wonder' on Level 9 and tearing it
Rumour has it that you can arrive at Level 58 through multicoloured slides within Level 0

exits.quote: isn't recommended due to Level 58.1 being class 5

exits.method: open supply crate with red number one
exits.quote: Opening a supply crate with a red number one painted onto it will send you to Level 1

exits.method: no-clip into exposed piping in Corridors
exits.quote: No-clipping into exposed piping in The Corridors will lead to Office Space EL3A

signature_mechanic: Decayed waterpark with dry pools and a noisy-corridor hub; free vending machines and Tegan Fruit stages; tribe and B.N.T.G. neighbours.
verticality: Slides and spectator areas only; no towers or depth stated.
content_warnings: child likely killed in slide-bin story
conflicts_notes: Class lines blank; footnotes 1-5 missing; tribe head-count 47 (interview) vs about 50 (Bases); Level 57 and 59 only appear in link list.
